title: Public Land & Urban Forest Ecosystem Valuation Ledger
description: Open JSON Schema for quantifying ecosystem service externalities (watershed hydrology, forest carbon stocks, soil stability, and municipal mitigation) in resource policy and site preservation plans.

jurisdiction_or_agency.description: Federal land management unit (USFS, BLM) or municipal tree ordinance jurisdiction.

carbon_storage_lbs.description: Total above-ground and below-ground dry biomass carbon stock (Nowak 1994 / Cairns et al. 1997).

stormwater_intercepted_gallons_yr.description: Annual avoided runoff from canopy interception and rhizosphere infiltration (Xiao et al. 2000).

air_pollutants_removed_lbs_yr.description: Dry deposition removal of O3, NO2, SO2, PM2.5, and CO (Nowak et al. 2006).

cooling_energy_savings_kwh_yr.description: Building shade cooling energy reduction (McPherson & Simpson 1999).

ctla_structural_value_usd.description: Compensatory structural valuation based on trunk area, species, condition, and location factors.
